answer_1.quote: Task-specific Natural Language Generation (NLG) aims to generate texts that satisfy desired attributes of target tasks, such as text style transfer and task-specific data augmentation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated texts for data augmentation and style transfer.

answer_2.quote: We use the widely adopted metric ACC avg in continual learning... we calculate the average similarity scores... using BLEU and word mover distance (WMD)... We use three automatic metrics, Style-transfer Accuracy, Self-WMD and Perplexity, to evaluate the accuracy of style transfer, semantic relevance and naturalness of the generated text, respectively.
